mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_follow (id, user_id, bar_id, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{barId}, #{createTime}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, bar_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bar_id = #{barId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_follow f JOIN tb_bar b ON b.id = f.bar_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
AND b.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\'
SELECT bar_id FROM tb_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
